mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates monetary easing, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains above 0.03 in tightening regimes.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in non-farm payrolls indicate robust labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC for the joint signal falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of elevated retail sales (RSAFS above 90th percentile), strong consumer spending drives corporate revenue expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS exceeds 90th percentile, or Rank IC for high spending regime falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index over the prior 3 months indicates expanding manufacturing output, correlating with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1,600,000 units annually, it signals a robust housing market that boosts consumer confidence and equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST > 1600.0, or Rank IC for high housing starts regime falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI and decline in federal funds rate signals policy response to inflation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as markets anticipate economic stability.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or Rank IC for the joint signal falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions with unemployment below 4.0% and payrolls exceeding 150,000, rising inflation expectations cause policy tightening that generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 150,000, or Rank IC for late-cycle regime falls below 0.03.
